title: Add a shortcut to copy @onready annotation to clipboard for external editors
body:

## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/15472

This creates a shortcut to copy the selected node(s)' `@onready` annotation(s) to clipboard for use in an external editor, mimicking the behavior of https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/60708. The main code is largely the same as in that PR, just simplified to only use the scene root path as there's no script context to draw from unlike in the editor case.

The shortcut will be visible only if the setting `text_editor/external/use_external_editor` is `true`.

No AI was used.
